title: The Last Storm
teaser: A storm over the Bonny River. Four letters sealed in red wax. One old lion who won't see morning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Before the storm. Before the letters. Before anyone died.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the night it began, in Jos, Nabyen Dalyop dreamed of a river she had never seen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Black water. A thousand floating lanterns. And a woman in white, standing on the surface as if it were glass.

lines.speaker: river
lines.text: Two halves, daughter of the Rock. When they meet, the river will choose.

lines.speaker: river
lines.text: Someone is watching you. Someone has always been watching you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nabyen woke with river water on her pillow.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And on her windowsill, three floors up, a single red rose that had not been there when she fell asleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Four hundred kilometres south, in Port Harcourt, an old man was writing his last letters.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Port Harcourt. The rain came in off the Bonny River like it had a grudge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the big house on the waterfront, Chief Gideon Okoro sat alone with a cup of tea that had gone cold.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ships in the Delta. Tin on the Plateau. Cloth in Kano. Money in Lagos. Everything he touched became an empire.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Through the rain-streaked window, for one moment, he thought he saw a woman in white standing on the river. He had seen her once before, forty years ago. The night his father died.

lines.speaker: gideon
lines.text: Four rivers. One crown. And not one of them knows what I have done.

lines.speaker: gideon
lines.text: Forgive me, Kaneng. I should have come back for you. For both of you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A silver spoon lay on the saucer beside his cup. A gift from Geneva. He had stirred his tea with it twice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere in the house, a door closed very softly. The Chief did not hear it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He sealed four letters with red wax, pressed his ring into each one, and called for his driver.

lines.speaker: gideon
lines.text: If I do not wake up, send them. All four. Before the vultures land.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chief Gideon Okoro did not wake up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By dawn, four letters were racing across Nigeria: north to the granite rocks of Jos, south to the creeks of Bayelsa, up to the ancient walls of Kano, and west to Lagos, which never sleeps.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Four houses. One crown. A death that started everything.

choices.text: Nabyen Dalyop, House of the Rock
Tari Ebiowei, House of the Creeks
Hadiza Lawan, House of the Walls
Kolade Balogun, House of the Lagoon

outcomes.title: The Daughter of the Rock
outcomes.text: You follow Nabyen. The letter in her hands has her name on it twice, and she doesn't yet know why.

outcomes.title: The Prince of the Creeks
outcomes.text: You follow Tari. The Chief pulled him from the river as a boy. Now the river wants something back.

outcomes.title: The Keeper of Ledgers
outcomes.text: You follow Hadiza. In Kano, the walls listen, and she has always listened better.

outcomes.title: The Lagos Gambler
outcomes.text: You follow Kolade. He wants the crown. The only question is what he'll trade for it.

m_storm.title: The Last Storm
m_storm.text: Red wax, four letters, and a cold cup of tea.

m_dream.title: The Woman in the Water
m_dream.text: Black water, a thousand lanterns, and a rose that should not have been there.

k_voice_gideon.title: A voice note, never sent
k_voice_gideon.text: Kaneng. It's me. Thirty years, and I still can't say it properly. I'm sorry. Tell her... no. I'll tell her myself. Soon.

epigraph.text: The river remembers every name it has ever been told.
